name: @codegen-x/kit-compose
description: codegen-x compositions on UI8Kit 3 primitives (Stack, Group, Grid, Title, Card*, Badge, Table*, styled Button, ...): one description (src/map.ts + variants/*.json token-only recipes), a thin build script, output per runtime like packages/kit. Candidates for the shared @ui8kit registry.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.react.json && tsc -p tsconfig.solid.json && vue-tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.vue.json && svelte-check --tsconfig tsconfig.svelte.json --fail-on-warnings
